fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) is trading at $153.93, up 81% year-to-date, and reaching $300 by 2029 would require an additional 94.9% gain from current levels.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $273.9 million, up 36.5% year-over-year, with data center revenue surging 46% to account for 79% of total revenue.
fields.summary_ko.2: Management raised fiscal 2028 revenue guidance from $1.65 billion to $1.8 billion, with significant impact expected after 2029 from expanded custom silicon partnership with Google.
